_comment: Ground truth for 4 real, public-domain medical images (Wikimedia Commons, CC0/PD, verified license+author) stored permanently in real_data/imaging/samples/ — not the app's /tmp upload scratch dir. ct_abdomen_real and mri_brain_real are documented NORMAL scans (no injury/abnormality in the source description), so must_not_mention includes specific fabricated-finding terms, not just cross-region anatomy — this is what catches a model inventing 'liver lesion' or 'acute ischemic stroke' on a normal image. pathology_real does show a real finding (anthracotic pigment deposition), so it only guards against cross-modality confusion.

cases.source: Wikimedia Commons: Chest Xray PA 3-8-2010.png (Stillwaterising, CC0 1.0)
Wikimedia Commons: CT of a normal abdomen and pelvis, axial plane 94.png (Mikael Häggström, CC0 1.0) — documented normal, post-trauma workup, no injury found
Wikimedia Commons: Brain MRI.jpg (Dr. Leon Kaufman / NCI, public domain, 1989) — no documented abnormality
Wikimedia Commons: Histopathology of pulmonary anthracosis.jpg (Mikael Häggström, CC0 1.0) — real finding: anthracotic pigment deposition
